description.value: The Cobblestone has been a community fixture in Cobble Hill since 1983, occupying the historic site of the Cowichan Creamery (1895–early 1940s). It operates as a locally owned, family-run public house serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner alongside an attached liquor store. Regular live music and weekly events make it a lively gathering spot for anyone passing through the Cowichan Valley.
